Name: WORLD_MAP_POINT_ICON_PARAM_ST
Description: World map pin icons. WorldMapPointParam World Map Point Icon ID and the site types' icon IDs are row IDs here; each row gives the menu icon that is drawn.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Menu icon (texture) ID drawn for this map icon number (retail 42000-42100, e.g. row 1 Grace = 42000, row 16 Field Boss = 42015).
